Class Game

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am31.am31.modelPackage.Game
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameObservable
public class Game extends Object implements GameObservable
Model class representing a running game of Mesos. Holds all game state (board, players, decks, current phase) and exposes state-mutating operations that enforce phase pre-conditions, throwing checked exceptions on violation. Observers registered via setObserverHandler(ObserverHandler) are notified of every state change.

  • Constructor Details

    • Game

      public Game(int nPlayers, GameResources gameResources) throws IOException, InvalidPlayersNumberException
      Creates a new game for nPlayers players. Game resources (decks, offer cards) are injected via GameResources, allowing tests to supply controlled card sets without touching the file system.
      Parameters:
      nPlayers - number of players (between MIN_PLAYERS and MAX_PLAYERS)
      gameResources - the card and offer-tile data to use for this game
      Throws:
      InvalidPlayersNumberException - if nPlayers is out of range
      IOException - if game resources cannot be loaded

    • gameStart

      public void gameStart() throws IncorrectMethodCallException, InsufficientPlayersNumberException, EmptyDeckException
      Starts the game: randomizes the first-round turn order, distributes starting food, fills the board lines, and transitions to RoundPhasesEnum.TOTEM_PLACING. Requires all expected players to be in the lobby.
      Throws:
      IncorrectMethodCallException - if the game has already started
      InsufficientPlayersNumberException - if not all players have joined yet
      EmptyDeckException - if the tribe deck is unexpectedly empty during setup

    • setNextPlayerDrawing

      public void setNextPlayerDrawing() throws IncorrectMethodCallException
      Frees the current player's offer tile, returns their totem to the turn-order tile, and sets the next player in line as the acting player. Must only be called after the current player has finished drawing.
      Throws:
      IncorrectMethodCallException - if not in action phase or the current player has not finished drawing

    • setUpBonusDrawingPhase

      public void setUpBonusDrawingPhase() throws IncorrectMethodCallException
      Method called from the controller of the game flow. Starts the BONUS_DRAWING_PHASE Must only be called after the current player has finished drawing.
      Throws:
      IncorrectMethodCallException - if action phase is not finished yet

    • playerSkipUpper

      public void playerSkipUpper(Player player) throws WrongPlayerTurnException, WrongRoundPhaseException, IllegalSkipException
      Allows a player to skip a draw from the upper line. A draw skip is valid only if the card line has no pickable cards, if the card line contains only buildings and in BONUS_DRAWING_PHASE since the bonus draw is optional
      Parameters:
      player - the player requesting to skip draw
      Throws:
      WrongPlayerTurnException - if it is not that player's turn
      WrongRoundPhaseException - if it is not ACTION_PHASE or BONUS_DRAW_PHASE
      IllegalSkipException - if the skip request is not valid

    • playerSkipLower

      public void playerSkipLower(Player player) throws WrongPlayerTurnException, WrongRoundPhaseException, IllegalSkipException
      Allows a player to skip a draw from the lower line. A draw skip is valid only if the card line has no pickable cards, if the card line contains only buildings.
      Parameters:
      player - the player requesting to skip draw
      Throws:
      WrongPlayerTurnException - if it is not that player's turn
      WrongRoundPhaseException - if it is not ACTION_PHASE or BONUS_DRAW_PHASE
      IllegalSkipException - if the skip request is not valid
